strategy.rule: NK sir (video SMky9fADQZw): BUY the discounted far-expiry NIFTY option (fair value from near-month IV), SELL nearer-weekly premium against it — buyer at discount + seller at price. Discounted CALL -> 1:2 ratio (profits if market falls OR rises; only fast momentum hurts). Discounted PUT -> spread. Shorts 1:1 (defined risk). 3 lots (225 qty) per Rs 5L model book.
strategy.exits: target +70 pts · time-stop 4 trading days · momentum exit on close through the short strike +/-25 pt buffer · expired shorts rolled to the next weekly (keep selling)
strategy.caps: max 10 trades/month · 1 open structure · signal: discount >= 5%
strategy.cadence: EOD bhavcopy marks (intraday fills approximated by closes)
strategy.source: NK Stock Talk session 2026-10-03; rules doc NK_NIFTY_PREMIUM_RULES.md
